```yaml
name: Kani Verification

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - '*'

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always

jobs:
  kani-verification:
    name: Kani Verification
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          toolchain: stable
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      
      - name: Install Kani
        run: |
          cargo install --git https://github.com/model-checking/kani.git --branch main kani-verifier
      
      - name: Run Kani verification on storage crate
        run: |
          cd src/storage
          cargo kani --features kani
```
